request.messages: the prompt below, as the one user message

content.thinking:
I'm weighing whether a money services business with a verified state licence still has to go to EDD, or whether it can be approved without escalation when nothing else applies. One option keeps the rule that MSBs always go to EDD, so the licence never matters. The other lets a verified licence exempt the business from that escalation, limiting it to crypto businesses or MSBs without a verified licence.

I'm checking whether an unknown licence status could slip past escalation, and I'd rather it lead to escalation. Treating "not verified" as including unknown keeps the rule consistent with how the ID check already handles unknowns.

I'm settling on the approve rule: an MSB with a verified licence would fall to approve unless another rule applies, so the fix makes that case reachable. I'll keep the rule's id, sop and text as they are, citing 5.2.

I'm wording the two answer options for the user, with the first keeping EDD referral for every money services business and the second approving a licensed one.

parsed.question: A money services business has had its state licence verified (5.3). Should it still be referred to Enhanced Due Diligence because it is a restricted industry (5.2)?

options.option: Yes, still refer it to EDD
options.says: Under 5.2 every money services business is referred to EDD, even one with a verified licence, so 5.3 never lets one be approved.

options.option: No, a verified licence avoids EDD
options.says: Under 5.3 a money services business with a verified state licence is not referred to EDD under 5.2 and can be approved if nothing else applies; one whose licence is unverified or not yet checked is still referred, and virtual currency businesses are always referred.

rule.text: Restricted industries (money services businesses, virtual currency): escalate.
